The site is Pine Crossing. I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team.

That answer comes from her own post in #central-team on June 9. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, and that a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce the problem with the store login. Nothing posted in the channel since then says it was fixed, and I couldn't see any account files to check further.
